en: A monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled at the base of wooded hills. The foreground shows a tree‑lined road and open fields leading into a compact settlement of multi‑story houses, farm buildings, and a church tower. Scattered buildings extend up the slopes, with terraced fields and dense forest in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "EGGENBERG BEI GRAZ."
